facts.text: Comparison basis: $1,000 held for 12 months; costs include trading and recurring costs.
BTC reference price $59,370 (SoDEX BTC-USD index); the SoSoValue price differs by 2.4 bps.
Cheapest way to hold BTC: SoDEX spot vBTC/vUSDC at 0.13% total cost.
Second cheapest BTC route: Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust (MSBT) at 0.14%.
SoDEX BTC-USD perp funding is 8.86% per year at the current hourly rate.
Holding BTC through the SoDEX perp costs 8.94% in total.
Strategy (MSTR): market cap is 0.61× its BTC value; adding debt and subtracting cash it is 0.70×. Price $76.76 from the SoDEX MSTR-USD perp (24/7 proxy).
7 of 7 treasury companies have a market cap below the value of their BTC (before debt).
Cheapest way to hold ETH: SoDEX spot vETH/vUSDC at 0.14% total cost.
SoDEX ETH-USD perp funding is 10.95% per year at the current hourly rate.
5 ETH ETFs are under $100M in net assets and are not ranked.
Previous snapshot (2026-11-24): Strategy's market cap was 0.62× its BTC value.
Previous snapshot (2026-11-24): SoDEX BTC perp funding was 9.20% per year.

note.headline: SoDEX spot is the cheapest BTC route at 0.13% total cost.

points.text: The comparison covers $1,000 held for 12 months, including trading and recurring costs. The second-cheapest BTC route is Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust at 0.14%; BlackRock IBIT costs 0.25%.
The cheapest ETH route is SoDEX spot vETH/vUSDC at 0.14% total cost. 5 ETH ETFs are not ranked because they have under $100M in net assets.
At the current hourly rates, SoDEX perp funding is 8.86% per year for BTC and 10.95% per year for ETH. The BTC perp's total holding cost is 8.94%.
Strategy's market cap is 0.61× the value of its BTC; including debt and cash, it is 0.70×. Before debt, 7 of 7 treasury companies have market caps below the value of their BTC.
